title: The Concept of Social Stratification
text:
Social stratification refers to the system by which a society ranks categories of people into a hierarchy. These arrangements determine unequal distribution of resources, opportunities, and power among various social groups.

Such hierarchies are not merely based on individual merit but are rooted in systemic structures that affect life chances across generations. Key dimensions often analyzed include class (economic standing), caste (ascribed status), and power differentials maintained by dominant institutions.
